subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app adopt a chat-first default or mode, accept only focused UX/media PR slices while keeping the current Overview/Connect-first companion-node flow, or move this discussion entirely to the mobile design RFC path?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies the user need with a mature Android Chat tab and related mobile polish, but changing the default surface or accepting fork-derived media/navigation slices affects onboarding, pairing, permissions, release posture, and Android product direction.

options.title: Scope Focused Android Slices
options.body: Keep the issue open while Android owners define narrow launch/navigation, media, and connectivity slices that need real-device proof before PR acceptance.

options.title: Keep Overview/Connect First
options.body: State that the official app remains an Overview/Connect-first Gateway companion and ask contributors to file only specific defects or small polish PRs.

options.title: Move To Mobile RFC
options.body: Ask contributors to post the chat-first Android direction on the draft mobile design RFC and close this repository issue only after maintainers accept that venue.

recommendation.title: Scope Focused Android Slices
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while Android owners define narrow launch/navigation, media, and connectivity slices that need real-device proof before PR acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README explicitly routes Android issues/questions/contributions to @obviyus, and the relevant chat-entry history also points to this owner area.
